profile.headline: UI Software Engineer  at Cisco
profile.summary:
Dwayne Lewis is looking to utilize his technical skills for achieving the target and developing the best performance in the organization. He would like to implement his innovative ideas, skills and creativity for accomplishing the projects.

Having graduated from Farmingdale State University and currently looking for a full time software engineer job that could benefit from his educational background and passion for engineering, while obtaining hands-on experience.

Specialist:  Swift, IOS Development, Web Development,HTML5, CSS3, Javascript , MYSQL, Database Management, jQuery, Customer Service, Knowledge of Mac/PC hardware and software

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Communication · HTML · Web Applications · Cypress · Webpack · Responsive Web Design · TypeScript · Unit Testing · User Interface Design · Technical Engineering · Presentations · Programming Languages · Software Development · JavaScript Libraries · Programming · Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM) · SASS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Communication · API Development · Databases · HTML · Web Applications · Responsive Web Design · TypeScript · Unit Testing · Technical Engineering · Presentations · Programming Languages · Software Development · JavaScript Libraries · Programming · Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM) · SASS

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
Diagnose and resolved complex application related issues.

Utilized SQL query to update, delete and read from Microsoft SQL Database

Maintaining and updating technical documents and procedures

Extraordinary customer service and relationship management experience

Assist in maintenance plans and upgrading schedules for specific organizational systems

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in Agile Scrum methodology and delivered accepted functionality in each sprint

Utilized Ajax to call upon Google API for login to the website

Used T-SQL to query the data from the SQL database

Deploy to Azure App Services to show website on the internet

Designed the user interface using HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap

Extensive experience with C#, T-SQL, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS – Angular 5, ASP.NET Web API

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
Troubleshoot calls from Optimum Online and Optimum Voice customers who are using the supported software/hardware. 

Provides the highest quality customer service while guiding and educating customers through established troubleshooting procedures.

Utilizes contact center applications such as Genesys, DART, Uconnex and Intelligent Troubleshooter.

Working in a fast paced and ever-changing environment.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Maintain and build out of website: posting gathered content and imagery from complimentary travel companies (using WordPress template)

Update site plug-ins, research and install plug-ins and widgets

Research forums, alter website code and correspond with WordPress Theme developer for new innovations to enhance end user experience and for troubleshooting

Email campaign management: build subscriber database, gather emails and upload to database, send email campaigns (using Mail Chimp and comma-delimited data format)

Interviewed new candidates and led team meetings

Working experience with WordPress, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Troubleshoot calls from Optimum TV customers who are using the supported software/hardware. 

Assisted customers with billing questions and concerns.

Worked in a fast paced and ever-changing environment.

Provided the highest quality customer service while guiding and educating customers through established troubleshooting procedures.
